tools.name: heal_malformed_json
tools.description: Deterministic JSON syntax repair: normalizes quotes, unclosed brackets, and boolean literals into compliant RFC 8259 JSON structure without data deletion. Use when fixing syntax-broken JSON strings that fail JSON.parse(); for coercing field types and verifying properties on already-parseable JSON ob

tools.name: enforce_json_schema_types
tools.description: Validates a raw LLM output object against a target JSON Schema, automatically coercing mismatched scalar types (e.g. string '42' to integer 42), injecting schema defaults, and pruning undeclared hallucinated fields. Use when enforcing schema compliance and type safety on structured LLM outputs befor

tools.name: clean_tabular_dataset
tools.description: Deduplicates repetitive lines or records, normalizes Unicode whitespace, strips HTML/control noise, and canonicalizes tabular text or JSON arrays. Use when cleaning noisy scraped lists, CSV rows, or duplicate log lines before indexing or analysis; for extracting typed JSON fields from free-form pros

tools.name: synthesize_safe_regex
tools.description: Synthesizes linear-time O(n) regular expressions free of catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) and validates them against positive and negative test strings. Use when generating and verifying a regular expression pattern for input validation or lexical parsing; for repairing broken JSON syntax directly

tools.name: compile_xml_agent_prompt
tools.description: Compiles a raw task description into a structured XML system prompt (<role>, <context>, <objective>, <constraints>, <workflow>, <output_format>) engineered to prevent instruction drift. Use when authoring or upgrading a system prompt for an autonomous agent or sub-agent workflow; for mapping a task

tools.name: verify_context_compaction_fidelity
tools.description: Audits a compacted conversation summary against the original full context to detect dropped user constraints, lost file paths, altered numbers, or missing pending tasks. Use when verifying that an LLM context-compaction summary retained all task-critical facts before truncating history; for generati

tools.name: route_mcp_workflow_plan
tools.description: Maps a natural-language agent goal to an ordered sequence of Diogenes MCP tool calls with exact endpoint paths, JSON-RPC 2.0 payloads, and cumulative satoshi cost estimates. Use when an autonomous agent needs to plan which MCP tools to chain together to solve a multi-step objective within a satoshi

tools.name: arbitrate_agent_deliverable_escrow
tools.description: Evaluates a worker agent's submitted task deliverable against agreed contract acceptance criteria to issue a deterministic escrow settlement verdict ('RELEASE_FUNDS_TO_WORKER_AGENT', 'REQUEST_REVISION', or 'REFUND_CLIENT'). Use when settling multi-agent bounties or verifying subcontractor deliverabl

tools.name: extract_structured_json_entities
tools.description: Extracts structured JSON records, named entities, dates, and financial figures from unstructured prose, emails, or HTML/Markdown dumps. Use when converting unstructured natural-language text into a structured JSON array of entities; for validating and coercing an existing JSON payload against a form

tools.name: synthesize_python_automation_code
tools.description: Synthesizes PEP 8 compliant, self-contained Python 3 scripts, data parsers, and CLI utilities complete with type hints, docstrings, and inline assertion tests. Use when generating a standalone Python automation script or parser from a functional specification; for summarizing existing documentation

tools.name: summarize_technical_document
tools.description: Condenses long technical specifications, RFCs, research papers, or meeting transcripts into high-density executive bullet points preserving exact figures and decisions. Use when producing a human-readable executive summary of a single provided document; for researching a topic across the live web wi

tools.description: Synthesizes a real-time market or technical intelligence brief grounded in live Google Search, returning strict JSON ('executive_summary', 'key_developments', 'sentiment', 'sources'). Use when fetching a structured JSON market/news brief with live web citations and sentiment classification; for summ
